senses.gloss: दैव- + गति दैव- + गति, f. the run of fate, Rām. 6, 94, 26.
दैव- + चिन्तक दैव- + चिन्तक, m. an astrologer, MBh. 12, 4454.

दैव दैव, i. e. देव + अ,
 I. adj., f. वी.
 1. Divine, Man. 1, 67.
 2. (with and without विवाह), m. One of the forms of marriage, the gift of a daughter at a sacrifice to the officiating priest, Man. 3, 21; 9, 196.
 3. n. The [] part of the hand sacred to the gods (the tips of the fingers), Man. 2, 59.
 4. Royal, Rājat. 5, 205.
 II. n.
 1. Deity, Bhāg. P. 3, 16, 4.
 2. An oblation to the gods, Man. 3, 18.
 3. Divine power, destiny, fate, Man. 3, 166; Hit. pr. d. 32; Daśak. in Chr. 187, 15.
 --Comp.
दैवक दैव + क, a substitute for दैव, when latter part of a comp. adj. स-, Together with the divine ones, MBh. 8, 1985.
दैवज्ञ दैव-ज्ञ, m. An astrologer, Rām. 2, 3, 18 Gorr.

दैवत दैवत, i. e. देवता + अ, n. A deity, Man. 5, 41.
 --Comp.
दैवतस् दैव + तस्, adv. By fate, Bhāg. P. 4, 7, 39.
दैवत्य दैवत्य, i. e. देवता + य, adj., f. या, Having as deity, sacred to, Man. 2, 189.
दैवयानेय दैवयानेय, i. e. देवयानी, a proper name, + एय, metronym. A son of Devayānī, MBh. 1, 3163.
दैवराज्य दैवराज्य, i. e. देव-राज + य, n. Dominion over the gods, MBh. 5, 522.
दैवराति दैवराति, i. e. देव-रात, a proper name, + इ, patronym. A descendant of Devarāta, MBh. 12, 11546.

दैवहतक दैव-हत + क (vb. हन्), []
 I. adj. Struck by fate, Amar. 46.
 II. n. A shock of fortune, Prab. 89, 17.

दैविक दैविक, i. e. देव + इक,
 I. adj.
 1. Divine, Man. 1, 65.
 2. Caused by the gods, Yājñ. 2, 113.
 II. n. An inevitable accident, Man. 8, 109; Yājñ. 2, 66.
दैविन् दैविन्, Lass. 27, 2 (read देवो, for दैवी).
दैव- + पर दैव- + पर, m. a fatalist, Kām. Nītis. 9, 36.
दैव-अन्तर्-इत- + पौरुष दैव-अन्तर्-इत- + पौरुष, adj. whose energy is checked by fate, Pañc. ii. d. 140.
दैव- + योग दैव- + योग, m. contingency, fate, Pañc. i. d. 197.
दैव- + वश दैव- + वश, n. will of fate, Pañc. 160, 17; 174, 25.
दैव-दुस्- + विपाक दैव-दुस्- + विपाक, m. cruelty (literally, the hard ripening) of fate, Utt. Rāmac. 164, 4; Hit. 18, 7; Utt. Rāmac. 27, 5.
